results.detail: Create POA Main (DTSX 22327) Success output is synchronous with exclusionGroup 0 (DTSX 24449), so every input row - including rows returned early and rows whose creation later fails - is passed to Union All Automated Joining Id For Update (Input 1) and Update Automated Joining (gen_testedtocreatepoa = true, main.cs:63-79). Correct.

results.id: L|finding#6
results.detail: From the files, PJ Update POA Main (DTSX 36979) Output 0 is synchronous with exclusionGroup 0 (DTSX 37747) and its catch only adds an Error row (main.cs:37-41); so by the files alone every input row, including a failed link, flows to Union All 2 -> Update Pension Joining and would be marked 3. A failed link stays unmarked only because the catch writes 'Pension Joining Id: ' + guid + ... (> 50 chars) into ErrorDescription wstr(50) (DTSX 37750-37752), which by documented SSIS runtime behaviour (DoesNotFitBufferException, not shown in the files) throws and fails the component before the row is passed on. The claim states 'קישור שנכשל אינו מסומן' as a plain fact without marking it as runtime behaviour not shown in the files.

wrongUnits.problem: Runtime-dependent outcome stated as fact.
wrongUnits.correct: 'לפי הקבצים הפלט Output 0 סינכרוני ומעביר כל שורה; קישור שנכשל אינו מסומן רק משום שכתיבת הודעת השגיאה (מעל 50 תווים) לעמודה wstr(50) נכשלת - לפי התנהגות SSIS המתועדת, לא מוצג בקבצים.'
